scripts.build: npm run types && npm run build:web && npm run build:licenses && npm run build:sim
scripts.format: cd .. && nix fmt && uv run --locked ruff format . && cargo fmt --manifest-path simulation/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: cd .. && uv run --locked --extra lab ruff check . && uv run --locked --extra lab ruff format --check . && uv run --locked --extra lab marimo check --strict --ignore-scripts notebooks && cargo fmt --manifest-path simulation/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path simulation/Cargo.toml --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib -- -D warnings && git diff --check
scripts.test: cd .. && cargo test --manifest-path simulation/Cargo.toml --locked --lib && WSORB_CHECKPOINT_INTEGRATION=1 WSORB_DIAGNOSTICS_INTEGRATION=1 uv run --locked --extra lab pytest -ra
scripts.test:transit: cd .. && WSORB_TRANSIT_STRESS=1 uv run --locked --extra lab pytest -m transit_stress
scripts.verify: result=0; npm run build || result=1; npm run check || result=1; npm test || result=1; (cd .. && nix flake check --all-systems --no-build --impure) || result=1; exit "$result"
